description: Trinkwasserschutzgebiete für Oberflächenwasser - Talsperren - Landkreis Leipzig is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Representation of the protection zones that are common for the production of drinking water from rivers. The protection zones differ in their degrees of protection. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water protection areas for surface water - Dams - Leipzig district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Trinkwasserschutzgebiete, Grundwasser. The listing shows 2019-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
